//: PRODUCTION environment. Identical application binary to TEST. The ONLY difference is the Gateway:Cloud block: Provider flips to Aws, the simulator URLs drop away, and the same seams resolve to KMS, Secrets Manager, IAM and the real Bedrock endpoint. No secret values live in this file.

Aws.//: Every AWS call this gateway makes -- S3, KMS, Secrets Manager, IAM and Bedrock -- is authorised by the credentials obtained here. The deployment is IIS, so there is no instance or task role to inherit and no access key is stored: the host presents an X.509 certificate to IAM Roles Anywhere and receives credentials that expire.

RolesAnywhere.//DurationSeconds: AWS accepts 900-3600 for Roles Anywhere regardless of the role's own maximum.

Certificate.//: The Windows store keeps the private key non-exportable and owned by the OS; grant the app pool identity read access to it. No key material and no passphrase appears in this file.

Aws.//AssumeRoleArn: Unused under RolesAnywhere: the session already carries the target role. Set it only to chain into a second role.

LocalProviders.//TimeoutSeconds: Local generation is linear in max tokens. Measured ~5.4 tok/s for a 27B model on a workstation, so a 2048-token budget needs ~380s. Size this to the largest MaxTokens an application here may request. Note the real control is the application's MaxTokens: a 6-minute synchronous request is a poor interactive experience whatever the timeout says.

Gateway.//Cloud: This block, and only this block, differs from Test.

Cloud.//BedrockServiceUrl: Empty means the SDK resolves the real regional Bedrock endpoint.

AccessControl.//BreakGlassPrincipalArn: The principal the break-glass key, and every admin STS token minted from it, acts as. Grant it in the access policy, alert on it in the SIEM.

Storage.//: PROD: real S3. Create the bucket with versioning, SSE-KMS, Object Lock if required, and a lifecycle rule matching RetentionDays.

Okta.//: Simulator off. The gateway validates real Okta tokens through OIDC discovery; validation and group-to-role mapping code is unchanged.

Billing.//DefaultCosts: Applied when an application has no rate card, or a request carries no application. Such charges are flagged as estimated.
